title: architect-v2 recorded answer
description: The executor's one recorded answer for an architect-v2 run (CR-8; references/architect-v2-contract.md section 6). Closed at every level: an unknown key is refused, never ignored. Every text the doc carries is one line (a line break would put a bare line, or a heading, inside a section of the load-bearing form); what a schema cannot state (the candidates and the razor, the traces, the docless gate, the review, the no-loss rule) is `record-answer`'s content checks, exit 5. A field a check needs is refused when missing, never defaulted.

text.description: one line of text with at least one non-space character

walk_field.description: one field of the walkthrough line: one line, non-blank, never holding the line's separator (the middle dot), which would forge a second field

walk_item.description: one item of the walkthrough's `must` list: one line, non-blank, never holding the line's separator (the middle dot) or the list's (`; `), which would forge a second field or a second requirement

free.description: one line of text, possibly blank (a blank value is a content refusal, not a schema one)

line_text.description: a new list line's text, without its '- ': one line, non-blank, never opening with '#', '~~' or '- '

trace.description: what the line traces to (station-loop.md section 8, rule 2): `ledger` a ledger line id of the scope doc, `repo_path` a path in the workspace, `question` an answered question of this run, `assumed` the executor's why. Any other kind, or a trace that names nothing, is refused at `record-answer` (rule `untraced`, exit 5).

new_line.description: a line this run adds, with its trace (a missing trace is refused at record-answer, rule `untraced`)

carried.description: a prior line of the living doc's section kept as it stands (its text without the '- ', struck or not)

strike.description: a prior, unstruck line of the living doc's section this run supersedes: struck through, never deleted; the decision to strike carries its trace

run_id.description: this run's id; `record-answer` refuses another run's (rule `run-mismatch`)

session_id.description: the executor's session, `answer_fields.session_id` from the adapter's helper, typed by no one; checked equal to the input's `invocation.session_id` (rule `session-mismatch`)

project.description: the project's name, the doc title's `<Project>` on a first run

trigger.description: the run log's `trigger:` (first run, idea blossomed, new precon, changed direction, ...)

changed.description: the run log's `Changed this run:` (`first run` on the first)

questions.description: every question put to the owner in this run, with the ledger line ids each touches and his answer (blank: unanswered)

about.description: which step the question belongs to; `scope-doc` marks the input gate's one question on a docless run

docless.description: present only when harvest found no scope doc: the reason the gate discussion landed on (the doc's `Docless:` header) and the home the doc goes to

exit_ramp.description: the answer to 'is there a system here at all?': `continued` true for a system and the interview went on, false when it ended here

walkthrough.description: the walkthrough target: all three fields present and non-blank (`n/a` is a value, blank is not), none holding the line's separator, with its trace

candidates.description: the candidate structures put on the table (two or three when the interview continued; none when it ended)

pick.description: the candidate the owner picked in his own words, by name; null when the interview ended at the exit ramp

diagram.description: the v0 drawing's `Diagram:`, one line (an ASCII one-liner or a one-line mermaid)

doors.description: the one-way-door check: what was settled (the run log's Step 3.3); null when the interview ended at the exit ramp

poured_concrete.description: the poured-concrete section in full: new lines, prior lines carried, prior lines struck

deferred.description: the deferred section in full, the same way

lines.description: the `NEEDS CHECK` lines of this run (an outside unknown not looked up), rendered in the Deferred section

review.description: the blind review: `pending` until its outcome is known, `declined` or `failed` with the date (and the failure's reason), `done` with the spine the takes agreed on (and `failed_lanes`, each lane that did not return), `not-offered` on a docless run only

failed_lanes.description: a done review only: each lane that did not return (a `READERS:` status other than `ok`), its roster row and the status and reason the `READERS:` line carried; the read-back names each beside the saved takes

rulings.description: the owner's ruling on each disagreement between the doc and the takes, with the answer fields it changes

publish.description: whether this run publishes the visual (the v1 default is yes; the input's `station.publish: false` makes it no)

publish_url.description: the artifact this run republishes to: the living doc's recorded `Artifact:` URL (the same URL across runs), null on a first publish or when the run does not publish
